senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. preced.; cmp. Assyr. ʿerêbu to go in, Del. Assyr. Handw., p. 126) to go in, (cmp. בּוֹא) to set.—Denom. עֶרֶב.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 14:3">Neg. XIV, 3</cite> <he>ה׳ שמשו</he> when his (the leper’s seventh day’s) sun has set; <cite ref="Yevamot 74b">Yeb. 74ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 35a">Pes. 35ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="E00722"><he>הַעֲרֵב</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of עֶרֶב) to be late, to do late in the day.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>, beg. (play on <he>שחרות כעורב</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 5:11">Cant. V, 11</cite>) <he>מי שמשחיר ומַעֲרִיב בהן</he> who works at them (studies the words of the Law) early and late; <he>ע״י שהשחיר והע׳ בתורה</he> because he was engaged in the Law early and late; Cant. R. to l. c.; Midr. Sam. ch. V; a. e.—V. <cite ref="E00723"><he>הַעֲרָבָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 12a:13">Ber. 12ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מַעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים</he> (‘blessed be thou, O Lord,) who causest the evenings to advance’, name of one of the benedictions preceding the recitation of the evening Sh’mʿa.
